items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Trommy Young, John Herder, Marlow Morris, they were all good players, man.

ctx.x: Q. When did you start performing as a leader of your own group.

-- Well I had this little trio, can't even count that, that's not even counted as far as jazz, that little Wynken Blynken and Nod thing. That was a step in the right direction I guess you'd say. But my first little group of my own was right on 52nd St. Right after the Tatum thing broke up. And I got plenty of jobs down there ... Trommy Young, John Herder, Marlow Morris, they were all good players, man. Who else, Jimmy Butts, Al Haig was there. Also Clyde Hart at one time or another. So that was my first thing as…
What made you decide to get your own group together?
